name: RoadCube
author: roadcubeapp

sections.description:
RoadCube will help store owners create and manage customer loyalty schemes and create complex marketing campaigns and make their customer be loyal to the brand and keep their customers happier. RoadCube will help improve sales and the customer retention with proven customer loyalty techniques.

Major features of this plugin include:
* Earn Points: Give points for every transaction done on your store simply by setting your preferences on the RoadCube platform
* Redeem Points: Give the option to users to redeem points inside your basket and give any gift you can imagine as reward
* Use data for marketing: Create your own marketing campaigns to target your loyalty members and make them do more transactions

Data Synchronization

This plugin synchronize customers, products, order and other order related information to RoadCube server(api.roadcube.io) using the REST API services to provide loyalty benefits to the customers in form of discount coupon at checkout.
sections.installation:
• Download the plugin
  • Upload the folder “roadcube” to wp-content/plugins (or upload a zip through the WordPress admin)
  • Activate and enjoy!
sections.faq:
How can I create a new account?

Go to www.roadcube.com and create your account. Then you will be able to get a token and connect your WordPress store with your loyalty system.

Can I have multiple store physical or digiital?

Yes you can. At roadcube.com you can have access to your panel and create as many stores as you like.

What is the pricing?

You get a simple per store pricing that you can find at www.roadcube.com.

What type of loyalty system I can create?

You can create any type of loyalty system at www.roadcube.com. You can give points and coupons based on amount or product transaction. You can also use different tiers and have gold silver etc users.

Where customers can redeem their points?

Customers can redeem their point at physical or digital stores based on the rules you set at your dashboard.
